payload.body: After your comment fixes, one code fix from dc's audit: molt_resleeve's failure line (lib/molt.sh:2189) says '<n> liberator(s) failed' with no 'of <m>', against hv's rule that a failure line says how many failed of how many ran. Count what ran as it runs, store nothing; add or adjust the test, both bashes, commit separately, unpushed, and tell vc.
